er014_output/four_type_observation_01/di.text: Silence can also feel difficult when we are alone. Across 11 studies, people spent between 6 and 15 minutes with nothing to do but think. The strange thing about silence is that it can feel louder than speech. Imagine a conversation. Someone says something, and then nobody speaks for 4 seconds. The pause may seem very short. A conversation can be going well. Then someone finishes a sentence, and no one answers. In one 2011 experiment, 102 undergraduate students imagined a group conversation. After a mildly controversial comment, some students read that the conversation continued normally. Others read that a brief silence followed.
